LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_GizmoDesc: {LINE}\n\nPress to see the path home from the side, hop by hop: the ground on the way, the line between the two aerials, and what decides.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_NoPath: No radio path to show: there is no radio here, or no powered radio station at home.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_ReasonBands: The two radios share no band.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_ReasonHorizon: Past the horizon: {KM} km apart, and the two aerials see each other only out to {HORIZON} km. A higher aerial at either end reaches further.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_ReasonHorizonGround: High ground stands in the line as well: {GROUND}, {AWAY} km from {FROM}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_ReasonGround: High ground on the way is blocking it: {GROUND}, {AWAY} km from {FROM}. A higher aerial at either end, a relay on that ground, or a way round it would get through.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_ReasonWeak: Too weak at {KM} km for this radio.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_GroundCosts: High ground on the way costs some of the signal: {GROUND}, {AWAY} km from {FROM}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_Operator: {BAND}, {MODE}: {MARGIN} dB to spare. {KM} km apart; the two aerials see each other out to {HORIZON} km.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_OperatorGroundOver: High ground: {GROUND}, {AWAY} km from {FROM}, standing {OVER} m over the line between the aerials. It costs {LOSS} dB.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_OperatorGroundNear: High ground: {GROUND}, {AWAY} km from {FROM}, passing {UNDER} m under the line between the aerials, close enough to cost {LOSS} dB.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_TermGround: High ground on the way, or the horizon
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_TermPath: Distance (the greater of free space and flat ground)
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWorld_ShowGroundTip: Looks at the tile whose high ground stands in the way, on the world map.
